welcome.title: Welcome to Córdoba 5579
welcome.subtitle: Welcome Letter & Directions
welcome.intro:
Hello and welcome to Buenos Aires!

We are delighted to have you as our guest at Córdoba 5579. This apartment was thoughtfully designed and equipped to offer you a premium, comfortable, and unforgettable stay in one of the city's finest neighborhoods: Palermo Hollywood.

We have prepared this detailed house manual to help you get acquainted with the apartment, its appliances, and building rules. Please read it carefully to ensure a seamless and enjoyable experience.

Jorge Orlando (project manager) and our entire team are at your complete disposal to assist you. Enjoy your stay!
welcome.directions_intro: The building is located at Av. Córdoba 5579, between Fitz Roy and Humboldt streets, Palermo Hollywood, CABA.

directions.title: By Car or Ride-Hailing Apps:
directions.content: From Ezeiza (EZE) or Aeroparque (AEP), we strongly recommend using Uber or Cabify for safety and convenient payment. Access is direct via Av. Córdoba. The building has no private garage; paid commercial garages are 50m away.

directions.title: By Subway (Line D):
directions.content: The nearest stations are Ministro Carranza (5 blocks away) or Palermo. Line D connects directly to Downtown, Plaza de Mayo, and Recoleta.

directions.title: By Train (Mitre Line):
directions.content: Ministro Carranza Station (Mitre Line) is located just 5 blocks from the building.

directions.title: By Bus (Metrobus):
directions.content: Multiple bus lines stop right in front on Av. Córdoba (140, 151, 168) or nearby on Av. Santa Fe and Av. Juan B. Justo Metrobus corridors.

local_tips.title: Local Tourist Survival Tips
local_tips.subtitle: Money, transport & essential tips
local_tips.intro: Essential information for international travelers visiting Buenos Aires:

items.title: PUBLIC TRANSPORT (SUBE Card)
items.content: In Buenos Aires, buses and subways do not accept cash. You must buy a rechargeable SUBE card (available at subway stations or large kiosks) and top it up before riding. One card can be shared by multiple travelers on the same journey.

items.title: MONEY & EXCHANGE RATES (USD in Argentina)
items.content:
Argentina operates with multiple exchange rates. Key options for tourists:
• Official Dollar: Traditional bank rate, least favorable for tourists.
• Blue Dollar (Parallel): Free market rate, higher value. Traded in cash at exchange houses.
• MEP Dollar (Card): The recommended option! Paying with foreign credit/debit cards (Visa/Mastercard) automatically converts your spend at near-Blue rates. It is safe, legal, and convenient for restaurants and supermarkets.

Scan the QR code to check real-time exchange rates.

checkin.title: Self Check-In Guide
checkin.subtitle: Step-by-step entry instructions
checkin.intro: For your convenience and schedule flexibility, check-in is 100% autonomous starting at 3:00 PM (15:00 hs). Please follow these detailed steps to enter:

steps.content: Locate the metal key lockbox labeled 'Depto 101' installed on the outer wall to the right of the building main entrance (Av. Córdoba 5579).
Enter the 4-digit combination code sent to you via Airbnb message a few hours prior to arrival.
Slide the side release latch down and open the lockbox compartment to retrieve your set of keys.
Tap the blue/black magnetic fob against the circular electronic reader on the entrance wall. The glass lobby door will unlock automatically.
Enter the lobby and head up to the 1st floor via elevator or stairs. Apartment is Unit 101. Use the physical key to unlock the main front door.

checkin.caution:
• Never share the lockbox code with unregistered third parties.
• After taking the keys, close the lockbox and scramble the number dials so the code is not exposed.

rules.title: House & Building Rules
rules.subtitle: Community guidelines & regulations
rules.intro: To ensure a pleasant stay and maintain great relations with building neighbors, please strictly observe the internal regulations:

items.title: NO SMOKING
items.content: Smoking traditional or electronic cigarettes inside the apartment, balcony, or hallways is strictly prohibited. Smoking is only allowed outdoors on the 11th-floor rooftop terrace.

items.title: NO PETS
items.content: Pets of any kind are not permitted under any circumstances.

items.title: QUIET HOURS & NO PARTIES
items.content: Parties, events, and loud noise are strictly prohibited. Building quiet hours are from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM. Please respect neighbors' rest.

items.title: NO UNREGISTERED GUESTS
items.content: For safety, common amenities (pool, SUM, laundry) are strictly for registered guests. External visitors are not allowed in amenity areas.

items.title: DRESS CODE
items.content: Walking shirtless or in swimwear in hallways, elevators, or lobby is strictly prohibited. Proper attire is required (swimwear allowed only in pool area).

rules.penalty: PENALTIES & FINES: Violations of building regulations incur heavy HOA fines, which will be charged directly to the guest.

climate_safe.title: Apartment Guide - Access & Climate
climate_safe.subtitle: Door locks, air conditioning & safe box
climate_safe.door:
1. Main Door Lock:
The front door lock automatically latches upon closing. Push or pull firm to ensure it catches properly.
Important! Always carry your keys with you when stepping out to prevent lockouts.
climate_safe.ac_intro:
2. Air Conditioning & Climate:
The apartment features two split AC units (living room & bedroom) with hot/cool modes.

ac_items.title: Turning On:
ac_items.content: Use the remote control for each unit. Press power and select COOL or HEAT mode.

ac_items.title: Recommended Temp:
ac_items.content: Set to 24 °C (75 °F) in summer and 22 °C (71 °F) in winter for optimal energy efficiency.

ac_items.title: Common Mistakes:
ac_items.content: Do not operate AC units with windows or balcony door open. This overworks the compressor and reduces cooling efficiency.

ac_items.title: Eco Friendly:
ac_items.content: Always turn off AC units when leaving the apartment to conserve energy.

climate_safe.safe_content:
A mechanical key-operated safe box is located inside the bedroom closet for your valuables.
Note: The key to the safe is attached to your main apartment key ring.
climate_safe.sofa_bed_intro: The living room includes a comfortable 2-person pull-out sofa bed. Follow these step-by-step instructions:

sofa_bed_steps.content: Remove backrest cushions and set aside.
Pull the lower metal handle upward and outward.
Unfold the metal frame leg supports onto the floor.
Fitted sheet with 600h Egyptian cotton bed linens.
Arrange extra pillows (located in bedroom closet).

kitchen.title: Apartment Guide - Kitchen & Minibar
kitchen.subtitle: Appliances, coffee maker & wine cellar
kitchen.intro: The kitchen is fully equipped with Samsung appliances and Carol dinnerware for your stay:

items.title: Electric Cooktop:
items.content: Electric resistance burner. Do not place wet pan bottoms on hot elements and allow to cool before cleaning. No built-in wall oven.

items.title: Countertop Oven & Air Fryer:
items.content: Includes a countertop electric oven combined with Air Fryer. Use wooden or silicone tools to protect non-stick surfaces.

items.title: Coffee Maker & Milk Frother:
items.content: Specialty coffee maker with built-in milk frother. Ideal for espresso, lattes, or cappuccino. Clean filter after use.

items.title: Fridge, Microwave & Toaster:
items.content: Samsung refrigerator with digital temp control. No metals in microwave. Electric kettle and toaster are on the counter.

items.title: Rice Cooker & Blender:
items.content: High-power blender with glass jar and electric rice cooker for quick meal prep.

kitchen.cava_content:
The wine fridge in the kitchen features curated Argentinian wines (Malbec, Cabernet, Torrontés), sparkling wines, and Fernet with Coke.
• Menu & Prices: Scan the QR code or visit alexismartyniuk.com.ar/cordoba5579/cava
• Unlock & Restock: Contact host Jorge on WhatsApp to get the lock combination or request bottle restocks.

laundry_items.title: Location:
laundry_items.content: Located on the 10th floor. Free for guests.

laundry_items.title: Washing Machines:
laundry_items.content: Commercial washing machines available. Detergent is not included (can be bought at local supermarkets).

laundry_items.title: Drying:
laundry_items.content: There is no tumble dryer. A portable clothes drying rack is provided inside your apartment closet.

sum_items.title: Swimming Pool:
sum_items.content: Located on the 9th/11th floor rooftop. Open during season until 8:00 PM. Taking a shower before entering is mandatory.

sum_items.title: SUM / Grill (Parrilla):
sum_items.content: Rooftop event lounge with Argentine grill. Requires prior reservation and cleaning fee ($10,000 ARS). Keys on 8th floor.

guide.title: Neighborhood Guide & Top Attractions
guide.subtitle: Palermo Hollywood highlights near Córdoba 5579
guide.intro: Palermo Hollywood is famous for gastronomy, specialty coffee, and nightlife. Top recommendations within walking distance:

Argentine plumbing systems clog easily. Use trash bins provided.

items.a: Yes, tap water in Buenos Aires is drinkable, though bottled water is widely preferred for taste.

checkout.title: Check-Out Checklist
checkout.subtitle: Steps before departing by 11:00 AM
checkout.intro: Check-out time is strictly 11:00 AM. Please follow these departure steps:
steps: 1. Turn off all air conditioning units and lights.
2. Close all windows and balcony door firmly.
3. Wash used dishes and clear kitchen trash.
4. Lock the main apartment door with the physical key.
5. Drop all key sets into the building ground-floor mailbox labeled '101' (or lockbox as agreed).
